themes.visual_character: Northern lights refracted through crystal — pure white background with single sharp indigo accent. Aurora gradient bar (blue→violet→amber) at top of content slides. Clean, restrained, publication-quality. The rainbow gradient is the only decoration but highly distinctive.

themes.name: laurel-crown
themes.style: Classical Academic Ceremony / Laurel Wreath
themes.best_for: Thesis defense, research proposals, doctoral presentations, formal academic ceremonies, comprehensive research showcases
themes.visual_character: Academic laurel wreath ceremony — warm ivory background with deep burgundy text. Laurel leaf SVG motifs on title/ending (bookending). Scholarly green accent with gold highlights. Formal dignity without stuffiness.

themes.name: carbon-console
themes.style: Dark Terminal / Server Rack Engineering
themes.best_for: Tech talks, engineering presentations, system architecture reviews, developer conferences, internal technical sharing
themes.visual_character: Inside a high-end server rack — deep charcoal background with phosphor green primary accent. Circuit trace SVG background atmosphere. Amber secondary. Server-panel frame on title/ending. Code-first design with codly integration.

themes.name: syntax-garden
themes.style: Growing Tree / Organic Code Learning
themes.best_for: Programming tutorials, coding workshops, framework introductions, language teaching, hands-on technical training
themes.visual_character: A garden where code grows like plants — soft cream background with forest green primary. Branch/vine SVG atmosphere in corners. Tree-frame on title/ending. Organic shapes with rounded corners and leaf markers. Progressive learning metaphor.

themes.name: gauge-panel
themes.style: Analog Instrument Dashboard / Scientific Measurement
themes.best_for: Project reviews, experiment reports, performance summaries, data-driven presentations, metric-focused briefings
themes.visual_character: Analog instrument control panel — light warm gray background with measurement-grid SVG atmosphere. Gauge-dial SVG decorations. Steel blue accent with warm copper highlights. Metric cards with arc indicators. Scientific instrument dashboard feel.

themes.name: field-guide
themes.style: Naturalist Pocket Reference / Bookmark Tabs
themes.best_for: Training materials, onboarding decks, technical guides, step-by-step tutorials, process documentation, workshop handouts
themes.visual_character: Naturalist pocket field guide — soft sage background with topographic-line SVG atmosphere. Numbered entries like species cards, bookmark tabs that stick out, compass markers. Deep forest green primary, warm tan for tabs. Book-cover border on title/ending.
